articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory, a new permanent attraction on the former factory site as part of its community revitalization work with the Macao SAR government. Developed with new media artists Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine plus local academics, the interactive exhibition preserves Macao’s century-old firecracker heritage as a community tourism landmark.

articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group is working with Macau’s Labour Affairs Bureau (DSAL) and local organizations on professional training and certification for team members. Since the start of 2026, about 1,500 local team members have completed more than 16,000 training hours, including Macau’s first advanced Chinese cuisine chef occupational skill assessment at an integrated resort.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, its 23rd consecutive year of support. Since 2004, GEG has donated more than MOP11 million to the charity.

articles.title: Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.rawDate: Nov.11 Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Sands China donated MOP 700,000 to the Macau Tung Sin Tong Charitable Society at The Venetian Macao, marking 23 consecutive years of support for the charity’s annual fundraising campaign.

articles.title: MGM Learning Festival 2026 Opens to Advance Government–Academia–Industry Collaboration in Talent Development
articles.summary: MGM, DSEDJ and DSAL opened the MGM Learning Festival 2026 at MGM COTAI on November 5, bringing together more than 30 government departments, professional bodies and schools to expand learning pathways for team members. MGM, the Macau Institute of Management and Zhejiang University signed an MoU, and three talent programmes were introduced covering academic advancement, professional skills and Chinese cultural literacy.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and gifts valued at over MOP 400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and 57th Charity Bazaar, its 23rd consecutive year of support. 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors volunteered at both events.

articles.title: Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.summary: Sands China partnered with the Macau Band Directors Association to present the association’s 30th Anniversary Concert at The Parisian Theatre, also marking The Parisian Macao’s 10th anniversary. More than 550 musicians from Macao and France performed for an audience of over 1,500.

articles.title: MGM Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Charity Event for the 19th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: MGM donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, its 19th consecutive year of support, bringing cumulative donations to MOP10 million.

articles.title: SJM Successfully Hosts the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction
articles.summary: SJM hosted the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction at Don Alfonso 1890 at Grand Lisboa Palace, with a live link to the World Alba White Truffle Auction in Piedmont. An 850g white truffle sold for €100,000; proceeds will benefit the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News (43rd Walk for a Million) and Tung Sin Tong’s 2026 fundraising campaign.
